info.title: Providentia API
info.summary: Authoritative Providentia backend contract through Phase 7
info.description:
Bounded identity, multi-home tenancy, published global catalog reads, and home-scoped offline synchronization prototype.

Version 1.4 adds the Phase 5 inventory ledger, counts, purchasing review, shopping lists, and dashboard projections.

Version 1.5 adds privacy-controlled, human-reviewed AI extraction.

Version 1.6 adds sanitized catalog proposals, role-separated moderation, icon metadata, redirects, and reversible product merges.
